unresolved_items.title: Server-Side Script Generation Logic on jqsvn.com
unresolved_items.unknown_aspect: The exact PHP backend script generation, license entitlement evaluation, and dynamic obfuscation techniques used on the remote server are unknown because safety rules forbid sending requests to third-party endpoints.
unresolved_items.clean_room_resolution: Clean-room architecture must avoid dependence on jqsvn.com. Implement an open-source TikTok Live connector (e.g. TikTokLiveSharp or open protocol connector) or self-hosted script repository.

unresolved_items.title: SQLite Multi-Statement Transaction Atomicity in CommitGiftCombo
unresolved_items.observed_boundary: TeamStore::CommitGiftCombo (0x060004ae) runs sequential INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE statements without an enclosing BEGIN TRANSACTION block.
unresolved_items.unknown_aspect: Whether original developer intended non-transactional SQLite execution or simply relied on autocommit without considering mid-execution power-loss failure modes.
unresolved_items.clean_room_resolution: SPECIFICATION DECISION: Clean-room implementation must wrap the entire CommitGiftCombo sequence within an explicit atomic SQLite transaction (BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT) with rollback on error.

unresolved_items.title: TikTok Web DOM Structure Volatility
unresolved_items.observed_boundary: Browser injection script relies on CSS classes and window properties that are subject to silent upstream modification by TikTok frontend developers.
unresolved_items.unknown_aspect: The exact rate and scope of future TikTok Live frontend obfuscation updates.
unresolved_items.clean_room_resolution: Architect the ingestion layer with an abstracted parser adapter and hot-reloadable rule definition engine rather than hardcoded DOM selectors.

unresolved_items.title: Discord Crash Reporting Webhook Payload Schema
unresolved_items.observed_boundary: AppLogger::ReportErrorAsync sends diagnostic crash dumps to hardcoded Discord Webhook URL.
unresolved_items.unknown_aspect: Full taxonomy of client environment metrics gathered during production crashes.
unresolved_items.clean_room_resolution: Completely remove Discord webhook hardcoded telemetry in clean-room implementation; replace with standard local structured logging.
